_comment: Structural map of the portfolio spreadsheet. Every skill reads this before validating anything. Update it when columns or row blocks change.

google_sheet._note: The bridge token lives in ~/.dgi/sheet-bridge.json (chmod 600) with the web app URL, never in this file and never in the conversation.

local_file._warning: Dead export from Google Sheets. GOOGLEFINANCE / SPARKLINE / IMPORTHTML become __xludf.DUMMYFUNCTION holding cached values. getYahooPrice() and getBVBPrice() are Apps Script and do not exist outside Google. Never write to this file and never re-upload it.

dividend_tax._comment: Total effective tax on US dividends for a Romanian tax resident. US withholds 10% at source under the treaty; Romania taxes the gross and credits the foreign tax paid, so the total equals the Romanian rate.
dividend_tax._critical: Column P is a CUMULATIVE historical total. Applying 0.84 to the whole string retroactively re-taxes 2024-2025 income at 16% and understates net dividends actually received. The factor must be applied per payment, by the year the payment was received. A flat string of summed numbers carries no dates, so it cannot be split correctly - that is the strongest argument for the per-payment sheet.
dividend_tax._open_question: Edge case not settled here: dividends declared in 2025 but paid in 2026. For an individual reporting foreign dividend income via Declaratia Unica, the year of receipt normally governs. Confirm with a tax advisor before relying on it.

dgi._note: Positions inside the DGI strategy. Included in all dividend aggregates, pie charts and growth reports. Since step 2 the row 27 aggregates key on the DGI flag column, not on these row numbers - last_row remains only as a structural hint for the audit and drifts if rows are inserted; the flag column (AA since 2026-07-31, formerly Z) is authoritative.

non_dgi._note: Tracking only. Held for visibility, deliberately EXCLUDED from every DGI calculation: annual income, income weight, dividend yield, yield on cost, growth years, DGR, dividend pie charts and growth reports. Dividend cells are intentionally left as N/A - that is correct, not a data gap. They MAY appear in total portfolio value and profit, because that is capital tracking, not DGI analysis.

K.name: Yield on Cost
K.note: Renamed 2026-07-31. Was labelled 'Div Yield' while computing Yield on Cost. True Dividend Yield now lives in column L. Do not feed K into criterion 2 of the scoring methodology - that criterion wants current yield.

L.name: Div Yield
L.note: Column inserted by the user in Sheets, which shifted every column from the old L onwards by one. Current yield on market value - the number criterion 2 actually needs. Empty on rows 19-25, like K.

M.name: Pondere
M.note: DGI-only since step 1. Non-DGI rows carry N/A. Weights sum to 100% within the DGI block. If a total-portfolio weight is ever needed it goes in a new column, never as a second formula shape here.

N.name: Div/actiune
N.note: No longer hand-typed. Derives the latest 'regular' payment for the ticker from the 'Dividends received' sheet via FILTER + MAX on year*12+month, so a raise propagates the moment the payment is recorded. Order-independent by design. Specials are excluded on purpose: this is recurring income, not total cash received.
N._units_warning: This column holds the dividend PER PAYMENT, not per year. Column O multiplies it by the payment frequency. Found by cross-checking the dripinvesting screener CSV and FMP profile lastDividend. Any literal entered here must be verified against 'Current Div' in that CSV, never against 'Annualized'.

O.name: Venit/An
O.note: Payment frequency is still hardcoded (*4, or *12 for O). Real TTM frequency could now be counted from 'Dividends received' - open item.

Q.name: Div platite
Q.note: SUMIFS over 'Dividends received' net column, keyed on ticker. Withholding is applied per payment year by the rate table on that sheet.

T.name: Comision
T.note: T13:T18 are still typed literals rather than formulas - open audit finding.

W.name: Medium price Last 365days
W.note: Header label is wrong - the cell holds a sparkline, not a mean price. Pre-existing, not worth a write on its own. Colour references fixed 2026-07-31 in W16, W17, W18, W23, W24.

AA.name: DGI
AA.note: Added in step 1 as column Z, shifted to AA on 2026-07-31 by the column insert. TRUE for strategy positions, FALSE for tracking-only. LIVE: the row 27 aggregates (F,H,I,O,Q,T) are SUMIFS(x2:x26,$AA$2:$AA$26,TRUE), so this column is the single source of truth for the DGI boundary. Sheets rewrote the references automatically on insert - verified by reading row 27 back.
AA._collision_note: RESOLVED 2026-07-31: refreshPrices() timestamp moved to MyShares!AC1 in Code.gs and in custom_price_functions.timestamp_cell. AA1 is safe.

Dividends received._note: One row per dividend payment received. Added to the config 2026-08-01; before that no audit check covered it, which is how the ARRAYFORMULA spill on 2026-07-31 went undetected until aggregates were re-read. This sheet is now the source of truth for MyShares N (per-payment rate) and Q (net received), so an error here propagates silently into every dividend aggregate.
Dividends received._append_rule: New rows get A:F and I. NOTE THE REVERSAL: F used to be an ARRAYFORMULA spill and this rule used to exclude it. Since item 5 (2026-08-22) F is manual, so omitting it leaves a silent hole that nothing fills. G and H ARE still ARRAYFORMULA spills, anchored in G2/H2 - writing any literal into those blocks the spill and collapses the anchor to #REF!, silently emptying the column for every prior row.

A.name: Year
A.note: Payment year, not declaration year. Drives the tax factor lookup.

C.name: Ticker
C.note: Must match MyShares column B exactly; the SUMIFS in Q and the FILTER in N key on it.

D.name: Shares
D.note: Holding at the time of THIS payment, not the current holding.

E.name: Gross per share
E.note: Declared rate per share. MyShares N takes the most recent regular value from here.

F.name: Gross
F.expected: D*E for rows before the Flex window; the real IBKR cash amount for rows inside it
F.note: MANUAL since item 5, 2026-08-22. It used to be an ARRAYFORMULA spill of D*E, and the gross convention then changed to cash actually received, so F2 is now a deliberate literal and every row carries its own value. THIS REVERSED: a new row with no F value is a silent hole, because nothing fills it any more. For pre-window rows sheet Gross is exact shares x rate while IBKR pays cash rounded to cents, so a half-cent difference there is expected and is not an error.

G.name: Net factor
G.note: Spilled from G2. Per-payment, keyed on the payment year, which is what makes the 2026 tax change correct for older rows.

H.name: Net
H.note: Spilled from H2. This is the column MyShares Q sums.

I.name: Type
I.note: Some tickers pay an annual special. N and the frequency check both filter on 'regular'; a mistyped value silently changes the per-payment rate.

K.name: Year
K.note: Left column of the per-year withholding table. Not payment data.

L.name: Net factor
L.note: Right column of the per-year withholding table. A new tax year is one new row here.

Cresteri Dividende._note: AUTOMATED 2026-10-10 by user decision, reversing the 2026-08-01 freeze. Every computed area is now a formula reading 'Dividends received', so it is a VIEW of the same truth, not a second copy: the per-year payment grids (one MAKEARRAY each in D20, D36, D52), the 2026 block's last raise (MAKEARRAY in S52: old rate, new rate, %, month of the first raised payment), and the raise counts per pay month (MAKEARRAY in C3:E14). A new payment row in 'Dividends received' updates all of it; a new position needs its ticker added in column C of the current year's block. S:V in the 2024 and 2025 blocks stay hand-entered history (raises before the first payment received are not in 'Dividends received'). Raise dates are pay months, not announcement dates. Still excluded from audit checks.

Evolutie._note: Fixed 2026-08-21 (BACKLOG item 4). H2:J4 used to be absolute references to fixed Total rows (B55/B109/B163) - fragile, since inserting a weekly row would silently shift a year's total onto the wrong cell. Replaced with a year-tag helper column (F1, one ARRAYFORMULA) plus SUMIFS matching on A="Total" and the year tag, so the lookup is by content, not position. Left as _note (not audited) rather than deleted outright, so the fix stays documented instead of the row just going quiet.

Watchlist._note: Present only in the retired local .xlsx exports. ClaudePortofoliu has no Watchlist sheet (verified 2026-08-01). Kept so a future session does not treat its absence as a missing sheet.

expected_sectors._comment: GICS sector per holding, used for a deterministic misclassification check. Keep in sync when adding positions.

fmp_sector_to_gics._comment: FMP uses its own sector names; the sheet uses GICS. Translate before comparing, or every row looks like a mismatch. Observed on live holdings 2026-10-11 (19 of 19 agree with expected_sectors): Technology, Healthcare, Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Defensive, Financial Services, Real Estate, Utilities, Communication Services. Basic Materials, Industrials and Energy are still inference - no holding in them.

fmp_plan._status: SUPERSEDED as a fundamentals source. Use the dgi-edgar MCP server for anything statement-derived.
fmp_plan._gating_note: FMP gates fundamentals per SYMBOL, not per endpoint. Measured with a direct curl on the user's own key: income-statement returns HTTP 200 for 4 of 17 tickers tested and HTTP 402 for the rest. The 402 body reads 'This value set for symbol is not available under your current subscription'.
fmp_plan._connector_note: Through the MCP connector the statements, analyst and discountedCashFlow tool families are denied for EVERY symbol, including the four the same key serves fine by curl. The connector runs at a lower tier than the user's key, so upgrading the subscription would not fix it.
fmp_plan._history_note: Obsolete: the earlier 5-fiscal-year cap note described a limit that is no longer the binding constraint. Per-symbol gating is.

custom_price_functions._comment: Apps Script custom functions covering instruments GOOGLEFINANCE does not. Source lives in setup/apps-script/Code.gs, Part B. KEEP THEM - they are load-bearing for SXR8 and BVBETF.
custom_price_functions._timestamp_history: Was MyShares!AA1 until 2026-07-31, when the column insert moved the DGI header into AA1; stamping there would have destroyed it. Moved to AC1 (verified empty) in both Code.gs and here. The trigger itself is still not installed.
custom_price_functions._timestamp_note: Written by refreshPrices() on a daily trigger. Custom functions cannot write to the sheet, so this is the only freshness marker. Empty means the trigger was never installed - run installPriceRefreshTrigger() once from the editor.
fixed_defects: Romanian thousands separator: parseFloat('1.234,56'.replace(',','.')) returned 1.234, a silent division by a thousand. Now parseRomanianNumber(), 9 cases tested.
BVB label regex matched 'Ultimul pret' literally and broke on a diacritic, extra whitespace or uppercase. Now tolerant, 6 markup variants verified.
Failure returned the strings 'N/A' / 'Not found', turning F=D*E into #VALUE!. Now throws, so the cell shows #ERROR! with a specific message.
Every recalculation hit the source. Now cached 15 minutes per ticker via CacheService.
custom_price_functions.remaining_risk: Both sources are unofficial - the Yahoo chart endpoint is undocumented and the BVB function scrapes HTML. Neither is a stable contract. They now fail loudly instead of silently, which is the most that can be done from inside the sheet.
custom_price_functions.totals_note: Since step 2 the row 27 aggregates are SUMIFS(x2:x26,$AA$2:$AA$26,TRUE). Rows 24-25 are now inside the range but excluded by AA=FALSE, and SUMIFS does not propagate errors from rows the criteria exclude, so an #ERROR! in E24/E25 still cannot reach the totals. That changes if the criteria are ever widened to include the non-DGI block - SETUP.md has the guard formula for that case.

edgar._comment: SEC EDGAR XBRL via the dgi-edgar MCP server. Primary source for every statement-derived criterion since 2026-08-01.
edgar._user_agent_note: SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent with a contact address and returns 403 without one. A missing config is a loud error, never a fabricated default.
edgar._gap_note: No price history anywhere means valuation methods 1-5 cannot be computed. A price-history reducer is the largest open gap in this plugin; report the valuation as unavailable rather than approximating it.
